text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A Saudi financial-sector study found remote work positively associated with worker productivity through job satisfaction and work-life balance.","cited_pids":["d3dba06e800d#2"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"A field experiment found remote working generally increased job performance, most strongly for mothers.","cited_pids":["ef88116f982d#1"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A meta-style summary of more than 50 studies reports a median productivity gain of 10% for focused tasks and a 4% decrease for collaborative tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A Trip.com randomized trial found hybrid schedules showed no measurable productivity difference from in-office peers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A panel survey of 3,123 Japanese office workers found full-remote work of five days a week was associated with reduced work productivity.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"In the same Japanese panel survey, full-remote work was associated with higher presenteeism while also reducing stress.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2","abefd158b9c2#0"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Conscientiousness predicts higher self-reported productivity when working from home.","cited_pids":["44ecc13330bd#0"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Partial or hybrid remote work can help productivity, while full-time remote work may hurt it.","cited_pids":[]}]}
